name: api-test-playground
description: Monorepo for API testing playground with Bruno and Vibe agents

scripts.test:all: for dir in $(find apiTest -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name "node_modules" ! -name ".git" | sort); do cd "$dir" && npx @usebruno/cli run -r && cd ../.. || exit 1; done
scripts.test:all:with-backend: cd backends/potter-api && npm install 2>/dev/null; PORT=3000 node app.js > /tmp/bruno-server.log 2>&1 & sleep 3 && cd ../.. && npm run test:all && pkill -f "node app.js" 2>/dev/null || true
